title: Need an opinion on my roguelike, it’s so hard I haven’t been able to beat it myself
author: Scorchyy

comments.author: gamerqc
comments.body: Played for a bit, but don't let XP vanish over time. Did you even play a Survivors game before?

replies.author: Scorchyy
replies.body: The logic is to force you to make tough decisions and not be greedy, you think that makes it less fun?

replies.author: gamerqc
replies.body: In general for Survivors games, there's too much info on the screen, so adding another layer with XP pips is kind of annoying yes. That said, your prototype is good, I like the minimal aesthetic, with more polish I could see it becoming great.

comments.author: Beginning-Search-983
comments.body:
Don't most of these games regen your health after you level-up? It's quite difficult to get anywhere with just the +20 health upgrade, especially since it isn't guaranteed. 

Or add a health item drop maybe?

replies.author: Scorchyy
replies.body: There’s one already, it’s the yellow rectangle that drop once in a while

replies.author: pricetag
replies.body: its so hard i havent been able to beat it myself
